# Santiago Jimenez Moncada

> Full-stack engineer based in Pereira, Colombia, with ~5 years shipping production platforms. Main stack: Django + Next.js (Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL). Currently creator and lead of an AI document-extraction platform for the City of Pereira, and founder of Parqueadero.app, a parking-management SaaS used in 14 countries. Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2).

This site is his personal portfolio (Spanish). Resumes are available in English and Spanish.

## Featured work

- [DIGER Pereira](https://digerpereira.com): Creator and lead (team of ~10) of the platform the City of Pereira's Disaster Risk Management Office uses to digitize psychosocial census forms of families affected by emergencies and report them to Colombia's national damage registry (RUD/UNGRD). AI extraction from scanned forms with multi-provider consensus voting (Anthropic, Mistral, Gemini) plus human audit; 46,000+ scans processed. Django/DRF, Celery, PostgreSQL, Next.js.
- [Parqueadero.app](https://parqueadero.app/): Founder and sole developer of a parking-lot management SaaS: ~130 active lots in 14 countries, ~1,600 vehicles per business day. Billing engine with 5 charging modes, offline-first PWA, native Android app, thermal ticket printing (ESC/POS). Django, Next.js, Capacitor.
- [Vatio Libre — Tesla Dashboard](https://vatiolibre.com): Remote contractor for a US client (New Jersey). Built a Tesla vehicle management and monitoring platform integrated with the Tesla Owner API and OAuth. Vue.js, Django.
- [Snowify](https://snowify.cc/): Open-source contributor to an Electron desktop music player; 30 PRs merged upstream (crossfade engine, live radio, audio prefetch cache, 12-language i18n, modular refactor).
- [NotificacionesQR](https://notificacionesqr.com): Real-time WhatsApp alerts for QR payments, Bre-B and Bancolombia transfers via Gmail API + Google Pub/Sub, with PDF reports. Node.js, Baileys.

## Skills

- Backend: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Celery, FastAPI, Node.js, Express
- Frontend: Next.js, React, Vue.js, Svelte, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Data & infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Linux, Nginx, PM2, Cloudflare Tunnels, GitHub Actions, Vercel
- AI: LLM integration (Anthropic, Mistral, Gemini), Claude Code, Codex, Ollama
